verdict.rationale: Segment's docs list official SDKs for JavaScript (web), Kotlin/Android and Swift (mobile), and C# and Java (server). It also documents a Segment Spec that applies across all its libraries and APIs, and shows a concrete analytics.track call. However, the evidence never shows the identify or page methods, and nothing corroborates the SDKs beyond vendor docs. Missing for 10: documented identify and page calls in the spec or SDKs, detail on per-SDK spec conformance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can collect events from web, mobile, and server apps through official SDKs that implement a documented tracking spec (track, identify, page)

citations.quote: The Segment Spec provides guidance on meaningful data to capture, and the best format for it, across all of Segment's libraries and APIs.
Identity Resolution allows you to understand a user's interaction across web, mobile, server, and third-party partner touch-points in real time
